_comment: Brand kit for Athletes Acceleration. Keys under `tags` map a layer's field name (its `tag`) to the value that replaces the layer's content at fill time. Built incrementally — add tags as templates surface them. Campaign/location overlays (data/campaign.*.json, data/location.*.json) override these per launch.
_note: BRAND-LEVEL identity only. Campaign-specific values (city, subhead, microscript, attention) live in data/campaign.*.json and data/location.*.json so they don't bleed across campaigns. Colors are left to each template (per-template gradients/tints); do not blanket-override them here.

tags.guarantee: +1 mph speed. +3" vertical. 90 days. Or your training is on us.
